/-- Shell-style glob on one segment: `*` matches any run of bytes. -/
def segGlobSpec : List Nat → List Nat → Bool
  | [], v => v = []
  | 42 :: p, v => segGlobSpec p v || match v with
    | [] => false
    | _ :: v' => segGlobSpec (42 :: p) v'
  | c :: p, v => match v with
    | [] => false
    | x :: v' => c = x && segGlobSpec p v'
